// TEST FIXTURE (brick 45917618, TEST-PLAN A13) — NOT compiled, NOT product code.
// A copy of a real create site (`transient-advertisement.ts`) with ONE extra direct
// `client.createSession(options.cwd)` that bypasses the session-root helper. The
// call-site enumeration in test/session-root-create-sites.test.ts must report the
// extra call as an unlisted site when it scans this file under the real file's name.
export async function readTransientAdvertisement(options) {
  const cwd = effectiveCreateCwd(options.cwd);
  const client = new AcpClient({ agentCommand: options.agentCommand, cwd });
  try {
    await withTimeout(client.start(), options.timeoutMs);
    const created = await withTimeout(client.createSession(cwd), options.timeoutMs);
    const bypass = await client.createSession(options.cwd);
    return { configOptions: created.configOptions ?? bypass.configOptions, models: created.models };
  } finally {
    await client.close().catch(() => {});
  }
}
